rule: SHA-256 over the file body with line endings normalized to LF (CRLF and lone CR become LF), a leading UTF-8 BOM removed, and the leading Lazy CRUD marker block removed; lowercase hex.
markerBlockRule: The marker block starts at the line containing <auto-generated> (line 1, or line 2 when line 1 is a bare comment opener such as /*, @*, <#/* or <!--) and ends after the line containing </auto-generated> (plus a following bare comment closer such as */, *@, */#> or -->). The body starts after that line's newline.

vectors.description: Plain body with LF line endings and no marker: whole body is hashed.
The same body with CRLF line endings: identical hash to lf-body.
Marker v2 header followed by the CRLF body: the marker block is excluded, so the hash equals lf-body.
A different marker (other generator version) with the same body: identical hash to marker-excluded.
Block-comment marker (Razor) followed by the body: excluded like any other syntax.
